segments.name: Proprietary Products
segments.description: Provides proprietary packaging, containment and drug delivery systems plus integrated services to biologic, generic and pharmaceutical drug customers.
segments.evidence: Our Proprietary Products reportable segment offers elastomers & primary containment, drug delivery devices, integrated systems, and analytical lab services, primarily to biologic, generic, and pharmaceutical drug customers.

segments.name: Contract-Manufactured Products
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and assembles customer-owned complex devices for pharmaceutical, diagnostic and medical device customers.
segments.evidence: Our Contract-Manufactured Products reportable segment serves as a fully integrated business, focused on the design, manufacture, and automated assembly of complex devices, primarily for pharmaceutical, diagnostic, and medical device customers.

revenueModel.text: Biologic, generic, pharmaceutical, diagnostic and medical device companies pay West for proprietary packaging and delivery components, integrated services, and custom contract-manufactured devices.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products and services are sold and distributed primarily through our own sales force and distribution network, with limited use of contract sales agents and regional distributors.
